present.label: Read the input
present.story: Guests arrive one at a time. We need two whose numbers add up to {target}.
present.formal: nums has {n} values. Find j < i with nums[j] + nums[i] = {target}.

initialize.label: Open the book
initialize.story: The ticket book starts empty: nobody has arrived yet.

need.label: Work out the partner
need.story: Guest {i} wears {value}, so their partner must wear {target} − {value} = {need}.

lookup:hit.label: Look it up
lookup:hit.story: {need} is in the book: the guest at position {partner} wears it.

store.label: Write it down
store.story: Write guest {i}'s number in the book, in case a later guest needs it. It replaces: {replaced}.

not-found.label: No pair
not-found.story: Every guest has arrived and no two numbers add up to {target}.
not-found.formal: Loop finished without a hit. Return None.
